result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to make *genuine understanding* effortless—between people, between cultures, between humans and the rest of the living world.

Not just tolerance. Not just information. Real understanding—where you can feel the weight of someone else's experience, see the logic in their worldview, and recognize yourself in them even when everything seems different.

So much of what we call evil is just walls. People hurting people not because they want to cause harm, but because they can't *see* the other person clearly. Fear of the strange. Fear of the mirror.

If understanding were as natural as breathing, I think most of what ails us—war, cruelty, ecological destruction, loneliness—would lose its foundation.

That's the one change. Not a new system. Not a new resource. Just... the ability to truly see.

What's yours?
